title: It starts at the spring works.
deck: Young workers, a football and the beginning of Albion.
imageNote: The team pictured ten years later, in 1888.
body: The club that became West Bromwich Albion was formed in 1878 by young workers at George Salter’s spring factory. Its first identity was West Bromwich Strollers; the Albion name followed.

The club’s own history presents the walk to Wednesbury to buy a ball as a legend, rather than an established record. What is certain is how quickly the team grew: within a decade, Albion were FA Cup winners and members of the new Football League.
